column1: # Symlinked configuration. bootstrap.sh installs these rows and doctor.sh
# verifies the same rows, so a new symlinked config is one line here rather
# than an edit in two scripts. Units needing more than a symlink — dev-dirs,
# gh, docker, claude — stay as functions in bootstrap.sh; config_claude calls
# config_links itself, so its rows below are installed like any other.
